window_note: Daily OHLC for SPCX from listing. The figure runs from the offer to the window end, which is meant to be the first post-IPO earnings release (Q2 2026), after which new fundamental information breaks the hold-fundamentals-fixed inversion. Closes are hand-entered from official prints; fetch_series.py fills open/high/low (and close where still missing) from Yahoo and never overwrites a hand-entered value. The events list is user-editable; 'expected' dates are estimates to confirm. CRSP/Russell additions are expected to fall in the September reconstitution, outside this window, so they are not listed.
